translations.translation: Please avoid using on areas with wounds.
If you experience redness, swelling, itching, or any other abnormalities during use, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.
Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
This product is not a medicine and should not be used for the treatment of any disease.
Use as soon as possible after opening.
Exchange and refund are available within 7 days of receipt.
